scope: All 153 canonical safeguards, every current checklist assertion, all 361 baseline item identities, and every explicit presentation trigger. This is content review, not an assessment of any client or whole-framework assurance.
method: Read each canonical official paragraph alongside its baseline assertions; replace evaluator methods, invented schedules and unsupported obligations; split independent obligations; preserve changed historical assertions verbatim under legacy_criteria. Fetch each of the 18 official CAS v8.1 pages, verify every linked heading, and compare normalized safeguard paragraphs with the canonical licensed workbook descriptions. CAS operational metrics and examples do not create checklist obligations.
source_priority: Canonical repository descriptions match the previously verified supplied licensed v8.1 workbook (docs/cis-pr33-final-corrections.md). Current CAS links are verified as real safeguard headings. Live CAS/workbook differences are recorded rather than silently changing official text or requirement membership.
limitations: No licensed agreement independently inspected in this task; existing user license confirmation remains the basis for embedded text.
Content tests catch structural preservation and selected important boundaries; passing them does not prove all wording semantically accurate independently.
